name: Benco Equipment
old_description: for automotive equipment, service and financing for your business.
about:
Benco Equipment, headquartered in Bismarck, North Dakota, has served automotive professionals and hobbyists since 1972. The company operates as a family‑owned, six‑location network across the Midwest and functions as a division of Automotive Parts Headquarters Inc. (APH), a third‑generation family‑owned aftermarket parts distributor founded in 1920 as National Bushing & Parts Company in Minneapolis. APH today supports nearly 300 Auto Value stores and employs over 1,800 people across nine states.

Benco sells, installs, inspects, repairs and finances a broad range of automotive service equipment. Its product lineup includes vehicle lifts (light, medium and heavy‑duty, in‑ground, scissor and mobile), air compressors (piston and rotary screw), tire changers and wheel balancers, A/C machines from Robinair and MAHLE, waste‑oil heaters, piping systems in aluminum, stainless steel, copper and galvanized steel, lubrication systems, paint booths, Tommy Gate hydraulic lifts and exhaust systems. Each of the six branches – in Bismarck and West Fargo, ND; Eau Claire, WI; Hopkins and St. Cloud, MN; and Sioux Falls, SD – stocks a deep inventory of lifts, parts and maintenance supplies, backed by factory‑trained technicians who handle installation, mobile repair and on‑site inspection.

The customer base spans independent repair shops, dealership service departments, tire retailers, heavy‑duty fleet operators and motorcycle/ATV specialists throughout the Upper Midwest. Benco also serves hobbyists and DIY enthusiasts through its public‑access locations, offering financing options and a finance calculator on its website.

The company emphasizes its regional scale – “we sell and service more equipment than anyone in the region” – and its commitment to compliance, with inspection specialists following the current ANSI/ALI ALOIM standard. Its differentiation rests on a combination of extensive local stock, manufacturer‑trained service teams, and the backing of APH’s nine‑state distribution network.
